```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false
# Data: https://ourworldindata.org/economic-inequality
income <- readr::read_csv("2025/data/income-share-of-the-richest-1.csv")
plot_data <- income |>
  dplyr::filter(Year == 2023) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(Country, "(WID)", negate = TRUE),
    Country != "World"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Country = stringr::str_remove(Country, " \\(country\\)")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    parent = countrycode::countrycode(
      sourcevar = Country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "continent"
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na() |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    value = `Income share of the richest 1% (before tax) (World Inequality Database)`,
    name = Country
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(-Year) |> 
  dplyr::filter(value > 10) |> 
  dplyr::count(name, parent) |> 
  dplyr::rename(value = n) |> 
  tidyr::nest(.by = parent, .key = "children") |> 
  dplyr::rename(name = parent) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(parent = "World") |> 
  tidyr::nest(.by = parent, .key = "children") |> 
  dplyr::rename(name = parent) 
jsonlite::write_json(plot_data, path = "2025/data/day_03.json", pretty = TRUE)
```
